<noinclude>
== Description ==
This widget displays world bosses and map meta events across Tyria.

== Subpages ==
* [[Widget:Event timer]] - main widget script
* [[Widget:Event timer/data.json]] - json with all of the event data '''(edit this page to add new events)'''
* [[Widget:Event timer/jquery ui sortable.js]] - full text of the jquery ui module
* [[Widget:Event timer/jquery ui sortable min.js]] - minimised text actually used

== Features ==
All of the below features can be undone by pressing the "Reset saved preferences" button, which reverts to the default appearance. Changes are otherwise tracked and remembered between browsing sessions.

;Settings box
* Checkboxes beneath the widget allow the selection of the following (please note these changes are not applied until the apply button is pressed):
** "12 hour AM/PM" - displays times in 12 hour format with the AM/PM suffix.
** "Compact times" - displays the times at the top of the page instead of beside every event. You can still find a specific event start time by hovering over the event.
** "Sticky compact times" - keeps the time in-view when scrolling. No effect unless "Compact times" also selected.
** "Compact headings view" - displays headings to the left instead of above each map meta. (No effect if headings are hidden).
** "Hide categories" - hides the expansion category headings.
** "Hide headings" - hides the map meta headings.
** "Hide chat links" - hides chat links for events.
** "Disable drag and drop reorder" - prevents rearranging of content by dragging and dropping (requires page reload).
** "Start at most recent hour" - if checked, the event timer starts at the most recent hour, otherwise displays a multiple of the event timer length. 

;Rearranging content
* Rows can be dragged into a new sequence.
* Rows can be deleted by clicking the [X] to the right of the heading.

;Time shifting
* Clicking on the "Next time window" button will increment the current time by 2 hours, showing you events in the future.
* Clicking on the "Previous time window" button will decrement the current time by 2 hours.
* Moving back to the current time window will resume auto-update. Clicking on the red marker will also resume auto-update

;Mobile device version (using Minerva skin)
* Limits display to a 1 hour period. Starts at nearest 30 minutes. Future 15m is hidden.
* Options to expand view time constrained to 1 hour by default.
* Can switch back to desktop preference to access other options.

== Usage ==
See {{tl|Event timer}}. For the final result, see [[Event timers]].

=== Parameters ===
;zone
:Optional. Zone abbreviation. If provided, only the given zone will be displayed (and the compact viewing mode will be used). Refer to [[Template:Event timer#Parameters]] for a list of zone abbreviation options.
:Multiple zones can be specified by separating with a comma.

;exclude
:Optional. Used on [[Template:Event timer]] to exclude events from the main [[Event timers]] page (which would ordinarily display all possible timers). Specified as a comma-specified string of festival meta events. Unset by default.

== Notes ==
* Originally based on code copied from the JSFiddle for http://gw2.ninja/timer by reddit users [https://www.reddit.com/user/fffam /u/fffam] and [https://www.reddit.com/user/rediche /u/rediche].

[[Category:Widgets]]

</noinclude><includeonly><style id="EventTimerCSS1" type="text/css">/* Widget:Event timer - Stylesheet  1 */
/* Frame and time markers */
#event-wrapper {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
#event-container {
  margin-top: 20px;
  color: black;
}

/* Time markers */
.event-pointer, .event-limit {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  height: 100%;
  margin-left: -1px;
  transition: left 1s ease-in-out !important;
  cursor: help;
}
.event-pointer {
  border-left: 2px solid red;
}
.event-limit {
  border-left: 2px solid #AAA;
}
.event-pointer-time, .event-limit-text {
  position: absolute;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  margin-left: -2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-pointer-time {
  background: red;
}
.event-limit-text {
  background: #AAA;
}
.event-limit-text.prev {
  display: none;
  margin-right: 3px;
  right: 0;
}

/* Container titles */
.event-bar-container h3, .event-bar-container h4 {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0em;
  font-family: "EasonPro","Times New Roman",serif !important;
}
.event-bar-container h3 {
  margin-top: 1.5em;
  padding: 0.2em;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(185, 177, 177, 0.5), transparent 40% );
}
.event-bar-container h4 {
  margin-top: 0.75em;
}

/* Event titles */
.event-bar {
  display: -webkit-box;  /* OLD - iOS 6-, Safari 3.1-6 */
  display: -moz-box;     /* OLD - Firefox 19- (buggy but mostly works) */
  display: -ms-flexbox;  /* TWEENER - IE 10 */
  display: -webkit-flex; /* NEW - Chrome */
  display: flex;         /* NEW, Spec - Opera 12.1, Firefox 20+ */
  border: 1px solid black;
  border-width: 1px 1px 1px 0px;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.event-bar-segment {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0.5em;
  border-left: 1px solid black;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background-color: #EED;
}
.event-bar-exit {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  padding-right: 5px;
  font-family: Tahoma;
  opacity: 0.2;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.event-time {
  display: inline-block;
  font-weight: bold;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-time span {
  cursor: help;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted #6E6E6E;
}
.event-name, .event-chatlink {
  display: block;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-chatlink {
  font-size: 12px;
}
.event-name a {
  color: #002BB8;
}
.event-bar-segment.future {
  filter: opacity(30%);
}
.event-bar-segment input.chatlink {
  position: absolute;
  margin-top: -2px;
  margin-left: -2px;
  display: none;
  width: 6.6em;
}

/* Reduced color option */
.event-bar-segment.segment-0 {
  background-color: rgb(236,230,230);
  background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 30%, #FFF), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, #EEE 10px, #EEE 20px);
}
#event-wrapper.fullcolor .event-bar-segment.segment-0 {
  background-image: none;
}
.skin-vector .event-bar-segment.segment-0 {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 30%, #1E1E1E), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 10px, #252525 10px 20px);
  background-color: rgb(50,50,50);
}

/* User preferences section */
#event-timer-legend p {
  margin: 0.5em 0em 0em 0em;
}
#event-timer-legend p > * {
  margin: 0px 10px 5px 10px;
}
#event-timer-legend p.options input, #event-timer-legend p.options select {
  margin-right: 5px;
}
#event-timer-legend p.options {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px 10px;
}

/* Draggable elements whilst moving */
#event-container > .ui-sortable-helper {
  opacity: 0.7;
  cursor: move;
}
.ui-sortable-handle {
  touch-action: none;
}
#event-container > .ui-sortable-placeholder {
  border: 1px dashed #AAA;
  background-color: #EEE;
  height: 3em;
  margin: 1em 0em;
}
/* Zone parameter specified - prevent user hiding elements */
#event-wrapper.zone .event-bar-exit { display: none; }

/* Times at the top - hide by default only show if class applied */
#event-wrapper .event-bar-container.event-t,
#event-wrapper .event-bar-container.event-t h4 { display: none; }

#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-time { display: none; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t { display: inherit; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t .event-bar-exit { display: none; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t .event-time { display: inherit; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t .event-bar { border: 1px solid transparent; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 0px; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t .event-name { display: none; }

.skin-vector #event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t { color: #EAEAEA; /* color scheme: font offwhite */ }
.skin-vector #event-wrapper.toptimes .event-bar-segment { border-color: #5A5C5E; /* color scheme: gray page border */ }

/* Times at the top AND sticky */
#event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-bar-container:first-child.event-t { position: sticky; top: -5px; bottom: -5px; z-index: 1; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-limit,
#event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-pointer { pointer-events: none; user-select: none; }
#event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-limit .event-limit-sticky,
#event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-pointer .event-pointer-sticky { pointer-events: auto; position: sticky; top: 3em; display: block; }
.stickytimes.toptimes .event-t .event-bar-segment.segment-1 { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9) !important; border-bottom: 4px solid white; }

.skin-vector-2022 #event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-bar-container.event-t { top: 4em; }
.skin-vector-2022 #event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-limit .event-limit-sticky,
.skin-vector-2022 #event-wrapper.toptimes.stickytimes .event-pointer .event-pointer-time { top: 7.5em; }
.skin-vector .stickytimes .event-t .event-bar-segment.segment-1 { background-color: #36393F !important; }

/* Compact headings view */
/* Singular: Compact headings view: H3 categories 220px to left, H4 headings 220px to left, wrapper js */
#event-wrapper.compact { margin-left: auto; position: relative; }
#event-wrapper.compact h3 { margin-left: -220px; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-bottom: 0.5em; }
#event-wrapper.compact h4 { left:-220px; width: 220px; position: absolute; z-index:2; line-height: 2.5em; display: inline-block; text-align: right; padding-right: 1em; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top:0; }
#event-wrapper.compact h4 span { white-space: nowrap; }
.skin-minerva #event-wrapper.compact h4 { line-height: 2em; }

/* Hide chat links */
#event-wrapper.hidechatlinks .event-chatlink { display: none; }

/* Hide h3 categories = just hides the h3 */
#event-wrapper.hidecategories.toptimes .event-bar-container.event-t { margin-bottom: 0em; }
#event-wrapper.hidecategories h3 { display: none; }

/* Hide h4 headings = just hides the h4 */
#event-wrapper.hideheadings h4 { display: none; }
#event-wrapper.hideheadings h3 { margin-bottom: 2px; margin-top: 0.5em; }

/* Caveats if hidden headings for compact */
#event-wrapper.compact.hideheadings.hidecategories { width: 100%; }

/* Multiple: Compact headings view + hide headings = pointless */
#event-wrapper.compact.hideheadings { width: unset; }
#event-wrapper.compact.hideheadings h3 { margin-left: 0; }
</style><style id="EventTimerCSS2" type="text/css"></style><style id="EventTimerCSS3" type="text/css">#event-wrapper.compact { width: 80%; }</style><script type="text/javascript">
/* Guild Wars 2 Wiki: Widget:Event timer */
'use strict';
// Verify this is the first time this script is being loaded.
if (typeof widget_event_timer_counter === 'undefined') {
    var widget_event_timer_counter = 1;

    // DEFER LOADING SCRIPT UNTIL JQUERY IS READY. WAIT 40MS BETWEEN ATTEMPTS.
    function defer(method) {
        if (window.jQuery) {
            method();
        } else {
            setTimeout(function() { defer(method) }, 40);
        }
    }

    // INITIALISATION
    defer(function () {
        // Event names, schedules, colours is now stored in [[Widget:Event timer/data.json]].
        $.getJSON('/index.php?title=Widget:Event_timer/data.json&action=raw')
        .done( function(jsonData){

            // GLOBAL VARIABLES
            // User interface buttons, labels, checkboxes
            var uitext = {
                widgetlink: "Widget:Event timer#Features",
                widgetlinktext: "Feature documentation",
                timezonehover: "This is your timezone",
                timeshiftresume: "Live update paused - click here to resume",
                timeshiftnexthoverpause: "Click to pause the live update and move to the next time period",
                timeshiftprevhover: "Click to move to the previous time period",
                timeshiftnexthover: "Click to move to the next time period",
                checkboxhover: "Use the Apply button after changing your preferences.",
                legendname: "Event timer settings",

                applysettings: "Apply settings",
                forgetsettings: "Reset saved preferences",
                deleterowhover: "Hide this row. Reset your preferences below to show it again.",

                checkboxes: {
                    usemostrecenthourstart: {
                        name: "Start at most recent hour.",
                        hover: "If checked, the event timer starts at the most recent hour, otherwise displays a multiple of the event timer length.",
                        defaultvalue: true
                    },

                    twelvehour: {
                        name: "Use 12-hour times.",
                        hover: "If checked, the timer will display times in the 12 hour format with AM and PM suffix.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    },

                    toptimes: {
                        name: "Compact times.",
                        hover: "If checked, the times will appear at the top instead of beside each event, further reducing the height of each displayed event.",
                        defaultvalue: true
                    },

                    stickytimes: {
                        name: "Sticky compact times.",
                        hover: "If checked, the times will appear at the top and stay visible when scrolling.",
                        defaultvalue: true
                    },

                    compact: {
                        name: "Compact headings view.",
                        hover: "If checked, the timer will appear more compact by displaying headings to the left instead of above the map metas. No effect if headings are hidden.",
                        defaultvalue: true
                    },

                    hidecategories: {
                        name: "Hide categories.",
                        hover: "If checked, the timer will appear more compact by removing category headers.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    },

                    hideheadings: {
                        name: "Hide headings.",
                        hover: "If checked, the timer will appear more compact by removing map meta headers.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    },

                    hidechatlinks: {
                        name: "Hide chat links.",
                        hover: "If checked, chat links will be hidden.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    },

                    disabledraganddrop: {
                        name: "Disable drag and drop reorder.",
                        hover: "If checked, drag and drop will stop responding after page reload, allowing selection of text. Disabled on mobile.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    },

                    reducefillereventcolors: {
                        name: "Reduce color on filler events.",
                        hover: "If checked, reduces color on other events to help focus on main events.",
                        defaultvalue: false
                    }
                },
                dropdowns: {
                    viewminutes: {
                        name: "Display period (minutes)",
                        hover: "Event timer display period in minutes. Disabled on mobile.",
                        values: [60,120,180,240],
                        defaultvalue: 120
                    },
                    
                    viewminutesfuture: {
                        name: "Future period (minutes)",
                        hover: "Event timer future period in minutes. Disabled on mobile.",
                        values: [0,15],
                        defaultvalue: 15
                    }
                }
                
            };

            // Calculate the user timezone offset for continued later use. Globally track start hour too.
            var now = new Date(), global_timezoneOffsetHours = (-1 * now.getTimezoneOffset() / 60), global_startTimeInMinutesUTC, global_setIntervalHandle, global_otherMinuteOffset = 0, global_usedHeadings = [];
            
            // Placeholder object which will become a copy of the event data, but only with the metas specified in defaultSequence.
            var global_customEventData = {};

            // Sequence in which the elements will render.
            var global_defaultSequence = Object.keys(jsonData.events);

            // If there are more than 10 elements showing, it's probably a long way between the first times and the last, so add another to the end.
            if (global_defaultSequence.length > 10) {
                global_defaultSequence.push('t');
            }
            

            // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
            // Utility function #1: Write CSS
            function writeTimerCSS() {
                // ** Sheet 2 - Event colour scheme **
                var cssText = $.map(jsonData.events, function(metaEventData, metaKey) {
                    var x;
                    var a = $.map(metaEventData.segments, function(v, k) {
                        x = '';
                        switch (typeof v.bg) {
                            case 'object':
                                switch (v.bg.length) {
                                    case 2: // linear-gradients
                                        x = '.event-' + metaKey + ' .event-bar-segment' + '.segment-' + k + ' { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(' + v.bg[0].join(',') + '), rgb(' + v.bg[1].join(',') + ')) no-repeat }';
                                        break;
                                    case 3:
                                        x = '.event-' + metaKey + ' .event-bar-segment' + '.segment-' + k + ' { background-color: rgb(' + v.bg.join(',') + ') }';
                                        break;
                                }
                                break;
                            case 'string': // transparent or other alternative text
                                x = '.event-' + metaKey + ' .event-bar-segment' + '.segment-' + k + ' { background-color: ' + v.bg + '}';
                                break;
                        }
                        // Add slightly more CSS control for segment 0, or if name is blank.
                        if (k == 0 || v.name === '' ) {
                            x = '#event-wrapper.fullcolor ' + x;
                        }
                        return x;
                    });
                    return a.concat([' ']);
                }).join('\n');
                $('#EventTimerCSS2').text('/* Widget:Event timer - Stylesheet 2 */\n' + cssText);

                // ** Sheet 3 - Compact window width **
                // Run once
                fitTimerToWindowWidth();

                // And rerun when the window changes size
                var resizeTimer;
                $(window).resize(function() {
                    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
                    resizeTimer = setTimeout(fitTimerToWindowWidth, 250);
                });
            }

            // Utility function #2 and #3: HTML5 localStorage operator functions used to request existing preferences, and store user preferences for later visits
            function getEventTimerPreferences(keyname, defaultvalue) {
                var response = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('event-timer-'+keyname));
                if (typeof response == 'undefined' || response == null ) { response = defaultvalue; }
                return response;
            }
            function setEventTimerPreferences(keyname, value, defaultvalue) {
                switch (typeof value) {
                    case 'string':
                    case 'object':
                    case 'boolean':
                        break;
                    default:
                        console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Invalid preference ignored:', value);
                        value = defaultvalue;
                        break;
                }
                try {
                    localStorage.removeItem('event-timer-'+keyname);
                    localStorage.setItem('event-timer-'+keyname, JSON.stringify(value));
                    console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Changed preference: ', keyname);
                }
                catch (e) {
                    console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: localStorage not supported (HTML5 browser required)');
                }
            }

            // Utility function #4: Create a legend with checkboxes for viewers to set their preferences.
            function eventTimerPreferences() {
                function addCheckbox(keyname, desc, hoverdesc, defaultvalue) {
                    hoverdesc += ' >> ' + uitext.checkboxhover;
                    var box = $(document.createElement("input")).attr("type", "checkbox").attr("id", keyname+"-toggle").attr("title", hoverdesc);
                    box.attr('checked', getEventTimerPreferences(keyname, defaultvalue) );
                    var label = $(document.createElement("label")).attr("for", keyname+"-toggle").attr("title", hoverdesc).text(desc);
                    label.prepend(box);
                    eventTimerSettingsOptions.append(label);
                }
                
                function addDropdown(keyname, desc, hoverdesc, defaultvalue, values) {
                    hoverdesc += ' >> ' + uitext.checkboxhover;
                    var box = $(document.createElement("select")).attr("id", keyname+"-dropdown").attr("title", hoverdesc);
                    var opt;
                    var optDefault = Number(getEventTimerPreferences(keyname, defaultvalue));
                    $.map(values, function(v){
                        opt = $(document.createElement("option")).attr("value", v).text(v);
                        if (optDefault == v) {
                            opt.attr("selected", "selected");
                        }
                        box.append( opt );
                    });
                    var label = $(document.createElement("label")).attr("for", keyname+"-dropdown").attr("title", hoverdesc).text(desc);
                    label.prepend(box);
                    eventTimerSettingsOptions.append(label);
                }
                
                // Create fieldset container with legend
                var eventTimerSettings = $(document.createElement("fieldset")).attr("class", "widget").attr("id", "event-timer-legend")
                    .append($(document.createElement("legend")).text(uitext.legendname));

                var eventTimerSettingsOptions = $(document.createElement("p")).attr("class", "options");
                $.each(uitext.checkboxes, function(k, v) {
                    addCheckbox(k, v.name, v.hover, v.defaultvalue);
                });
                $.each(uitext.dropdowns, function(k, v) {
                    addDropdown(k, v.name, v.hover, v.defaultvalue, v.values);
                });
                eventTimerSettings.append(eventTimerSettingsOptions);

                var eventTimerSettingsButtons = $(document.createElement("p")).attr("class", "buttons");
                eventTimerSettingsButtons.append($(document.createElement("input")).attr("id", "apply-button").attr("class", "mw-ui-button button").attr("type", "button").attr("value", uitext.applysettings));
                eventTimerSettingsButtons.append($(document.createElement("input")).attr("id", "forget-button").attr("class", "mw-ui-button button").attr("type", "button").attr("value", uitext.forgetsettings));
                eventTimerSettingsButtons.append($(document.createElement("span"))
                    .append(wikiLink(uitext.widgetlink, uitext.widgetlinktext))
                );
                eventTimerSettings.append(eventTimerSettingsButtons);
                
                $('#event-wrapper').after(eventTimerSettings);

                // Save checkbox and dropdown settings
                $.each(uitext.checkboxes, function(k, v) {
                    $('#' + k + '-toggle').click(function() {
                        setEventTimerPreferences(k, $('#' + k + '-toggle').prop('checked'), v.defaultvalue);
                    });
                });
                $.each(uitext.dropdowns, function(k, v) {
                    $('#' + k + '-dropdown').on('change', function() {
                        setEventTimerPreferences(k, $('#' + k + '-dropdown option:selected').prop('value'), v.defaultvalue);
                    });
                });
                
                // Bind buttons
                $('#apply-button').click(function() {
                    mainEventTimer(true, false);
                });
                $('#forget-button').click(function() {
                    try {
                        // Remove local storage and reset checkboxes
                        localStorage.removeItem('event-timer-version');
                        localStorage.removeItem('event-timer-sequence');
                        $.each(uitext.checkboxes, function(k, v) {
                            localStorage.removeItem('event-timer-' + k);
                            $('#' + k + '-toggle').prop('checked', v.defaultvalue);
                        });
                        $.each(uitext.dropdowns, function(k, v) {
                            localStorage.removeItem('event-timer-' + k);
                            $('#' + k + '-dropdown option[selected]').prop('selected',null);
                            $('#' + k + '-dropdown option[value="' + v.defaultvalue + '"]').prop('selected', 'selected');
                        });
                        console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Removed stored event timer preferences.');
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: localStorage not supported (HTML5 browser required)');
                    }
                    mainEventTimer(true, false);
                });
            }

            // Utility function #5: Convert a time given in minutes since 00:00 into a recognizable time. (1440 = one whole day, 1515 = one whole schedule day)
            function unwrapUTC(preferences, time) {
                var timeRaw, timeString;

                // Check combined offset in hours is not beyond 23:59
                time = time % 1440;

                // Calculate the hours and minutes
                var hour = Math.floor( time/60 );
                var minute = time % 60;

                // If timezone offset is zero, use UTC time and don't bother with date objects, otherwise use local time
                if (global_timezoneOffsetHours == 0) {
                    if (preferences.useTwelveHour == false) {
                        timeRaw = pad(hour) + ':' + pad(minute);
                        timeString = pad(hour) + ':' + pad(minute);
                    } else {
                        timeRaw = (((hour + 11) % 12) + 1) + ':' + pad(minute) + ' ' + (hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM');
                        timeString = (((hour + 11) % 12) + 1) + ':' + pad(minute) + ' ' + (hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM');
                    }
                } else {
                    var date = new Date();
                    date.setUTCHours(hour, minute, 0, 0);
                    if (preferences.useTwelveHour == false) {
                        timeRaw = pad(date.getHours()) + ':' + pad(date.getMinutes());
                        // mobile failed below due to text "(global_timezoneOffsetHours < 0"
                        timeString = $(document.createElement("span"))
                            .attr("title", uitext.timezonehover + " (UTC" + (global_timezoneOffsetHours < 0 ? "" : "+" ) + global_timezoneOffsetHours + ")")
                            .text(pad(date.getHours()) + ':' + pad(date.getMinutes()));
                    } else {
                        timeRaw = (((date.getHours() + 11) % 12) + 1) + ':' + pad(date.getMinutes()) + ' ' + (date.getHours() >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM');
                        timeString = $(document.createElement("span"))
                            .attr("title", uitext.timezonehover + " (UTC" + (global_timezoneOffsetHours < 0 ? "" : "+" ) + global_timezoneOffsetHours + ")")
                            .text((((date.getHours() + 11) % 12) + 1) + ":" + pad(date.getMinutes()) + " " + (date.getHours() >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"));
                    }
                }
                return { raw: timeRaw, string: timeString };
            }

            // Utility function #6: Zero pad numbers into strings of character length two.
            function pad(s) {
                return (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
            }

            // Utility function #7: Create a one-click select element for a chatlink.
            function chatLinkSelect(chatLinkCode) {
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                span.innerHTML = chatLinkCode;

                var input = document.createElement('input');
                input.className = 'chatlink';
                input.type = 'text';
                input.value = chatLinkCode;
                input.readOnly = true;
                input.spellcheck = false;

                $(span).click(function () {

            // Utility function #8: Draw blocks for the given object
            function drawRow(preferences, metaKey, metaSingular ) {
                // Create a bar container (this will hold the bar and the associated title)
                var barcontainer = $(document.createElement("div")).attr("class", "event-bar-container category-" + metaKey.split("-")[0] + " event-" + metaKey).attr("data-abbr", metaKey);

                // Display category if not used before
                // Note that the "id" anchor can be used to cheese the Table of Contents (TOC). If the categories are hidden however (preference: "hide categories" then the TOC entry won't work)
                if ( typeof metaSingular.category != 'undefined' && metaSingular.category !== '' && global_usedHeadings.indexOf( metaSingular.category ) == -1 ) {
                    global_usedHeadings.push( metaSingular.category );
                    barcontainer.append($(document.createElement("h3")).attr("id", metaSingular.category.replace(/ /g, "_")).attr("class", metaKey).text(metaSingular.category));

                if ( typeof metaSingular.link != 'undefined' ) {

                    );
                } else {
                    if (metaSingular.name !== '') {
                        barcontainer.append($(document.createElement("h4"))
                            .append($(document.createElement("span"))
                                .append(wikiLink(metaSingular.name))
                            )
                        );
                    } else {
                        barcontainer.append($(document.createElement("h4"))

                $.each( metaSingular.sequences.refined, function(i, v) {

                    var time = unwrapUTC(preferences, v['s']);

                    // Create a segment to represent that phase, and set the width based on the duration
                    var segment = $(document.createElement("div"))
                        .attr("class", "event-bar-segment" + " segment-" + v.r + " " + v.cl).css("width", (100*v["d"]/(preferences.viewMinutes + preferences.viewMinutesFuture)) + "%")
                        .attr("title", (metaSingular.name ? metaSingular.name + "\r" : "") + time.raw + (name == "" ? "" : " - ") + name);

                    var segmentTime = $(document.createElement("span")).attr("class", "event-time")

                    segment.append(segmentTime);

                        .append(link == "" ? document.createTextNode(name) : wikiLink(link, name)));

            // Utility function #9: Refine the schedule from 1515 minutes to the viewing window (typically 135 minutes). Firstly apply a rough filter around the window, then truncate to ensure events are within the window.
            function filterEventData(preferences, metas) {
                function refineRow(preferences, schedule, metaKey) {
                    // Window start (ws), future (wf) and end (we) times in minutes
                    var ws = global_startTimeInMinutesUTC;
                    var wf = ws + preferences.viewMinutes;
                    var we = ws + preferences.viewMinutes + preferences.viewMinutesFuture;

                    // Filter the data down from 24 hours to the maximum viewing window.
                    function timeWithinWindow(schedule) {
                        return ( (schedule.e > ws && schedule.s < we) );
                    }
                    var roughSchedule = schedule.filter(timeWithinWindow);

                    // Refine the data to restrict lengths to visible window
                    var refinedSchedule = [];
                    $.each(roughSchedule, function(i, v) {
                        // Local copies that we can adjust
                        var r = v.r, s = v.s, e = v.e;

                        // Check if window starts after the segment started, if so, crop it
                        if ( ws > s ) {
                            s = ws;
                            if (metaKey == 'hot-ds' && r == 1) {
                                r = 0; // Special case: Dragon's Stand (modify to "(continued)")
                            }
                        }

                        // Check end of segment is before window end, if not, crop it
                        if ( e > we ) {
                            e = we;
                        }

                        // Check if segment crosses the 2 hour marker, if it does, split into two
                        if ( s < wf && wf < e ) {
                            // Two objects, one beginning to the left of the future line + ending at the future line, and one starting at the future line
                            refinedSchedule.push({
                                r: r,      // Reference id, e.g. wb1
                                s: s,      // Start minutes, e.g. 10
                                e: wf,     // End minutes, e.g. 60
                                d: wf - s, // Duration, e.g. 50
                                cl: ''     // Class placeholder only used for future last 15 minutes segments
                            });
                            if (metaKey == 'hot-ds' && r == 1) {
                                r = 0; // Special case: Dragon's Stand future (modify to "(continued)")
                            }
                            refinedSchedule.push({
                                r: r,
                                s: wf,
                                e: e,
                                d: e - wf,
                                cl: ' future'
                            });
                        } else if ( wf < e ) {
                            // Just one object, with the ending after the future line + beginning on or after future line
                            refinedSchedule.push({
                                r: r,
                                s: s,
                                e: e,
                                d: e - s,
                                cl: ' future'
                            });
                        } else {
                            // Just one object, with the ending on or before the future line
                            refinedSchedule.push({
                                r: r,
                                s: s,
                                e: e,
                                d: e - s,
                                cl: ''
                            });
                        }
                    });
                    return refinedSchedule;
                }

                // Refine schedule to fit viewing minutes.
                $.each(metas, function(k, v) {
                    metas[k].sequences.refined = refineRow(preferences, v.sequences.full, k);
                });
                return metas;
            }

            // Utility function #10: Draw meta event "phases" as segments within map "bars" for each meta.
            function createEventBars(preferences, global_otherMinuteOffset) {
                // All event bars and segments need to be created with the same start time
                var now = new Date();
                global_startTimeInMinutesUTC = now.getUTCHours() * 60;

                // If using mobile, if beyond the half hour mark, just start from there.
                if (preferences.viewStart === 'half-hourly' && now.getUTCMinutes() >= 30) {
                    global_startTimeInMinutesUTC = global_startTimeInMinutesUTC + 30;
                }

                // Check if an offset is specified, contain within a 24hr day (1440m)
                if (global_otherMinuteOffset) {
                    global_startTimeInMinutesUTC = (global_startTimeInMinutesUTC + global_otherMinuteOffset) % 1440;
                }

                // If not using starting at the most recent hour, start at multiple of event timer length
                if (preferences.useMostRecentHourStart === false && preferences.viewMinutes > 60) {
                    global_startTimeInMinutesUTC = Math.floor(global_startTimeInMinutesUTC / preferences.viewMinutes) * preferences.viewMinutes;
                }

                // Filter the schedule for the current event viewing window
                global_customEventData = filterEventData(preferences, global_customEventData);

                // Reset any previously set category heading tracking
                global_usedHeadings = [];

                // Do the work
                $.each(preferences.metaSequence, function(i, metaKey) {
                    drawRow(preferences, metaKey, global_customEventData[metaKey] );
                });

                // Allow reordering of elements
                if (preferences.disableDragAndDrop === false) {
                    $('#event-container').sortable({
                        placeholder: 'ui-sortable-placeholder',
                        update: function() {
                            // Update stored values
                            var eventBars = $('.event-bar-container');
                            var eventAbbrs = [];
                            $.each(eventBars, function() {
                                eventAbbrs.push(this.getAttribute('data-abbr'));
                            });
                            setEventTimerPreferences('sequence',eventAbbrs, global_defaultSequence);
                            console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Rearranged sequence to: ' + JSON.stringify(eventAbbrs));

                            // Now reload otherwise people whine about category titles.
                            mainEventTimer(true, false);
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Allow closure of event bars
                $('.event-bar-exit').click(function() {
                    var eventBar = this.closest('.event-bar-container');
                    var eventAbbr = eventBar.getAttribute('data-abbr');
                    var currentPref = getEventTimerPreferences('sequence', global_defaultSequence);

                    // Adjust stored preferences to remove given element from preferences
                    var abbrIndex = currentPref.indexOf(eventAbbr);
                    if ( abbrIndex > -1 ) {
                        currentPref.splice(abbrIndex,1);
                    }
                    setEventTimerPreferences('sequence',currentPref, global_defaultSequence);
                    console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Deleted element. Remaining sequence: ' + JSON.stringify(currentPref));
                    
                    // Check if remaining sequence is only length 2 (i.e. only the the top and bottom times remain - everything else deleted)
                    // If so, reset the sequence entirely.
                    var revisedCurrentPref = getEventTimerPreferences('sequence', global_defaultSequence);
                    if (revisedCurrentPref.length === 2) {
                        setEventTimerPreferences('sequence', global_defaultSequence);
                    }

                    // Now reload otherwise people whine about category titles.
                    mainEventTimer(true, false);
                });
            }

            // Utility function #11: Generate a full day of meta pattern
            function eventsGenerator(preferences, eventData) {
                function fullPatternGenerator(preferences, partial, pattern){
                    // A full day plus the viewing window (basically what would somebody see if they looked 1 minute before midnight, plus a bit of margin)
                    var fillDuration = (60*24) + preferences.viewMinutes + preferences.viewMinutesFuture;

                    // Figure out total length of partial
                    var partialDuration = 0; $.map(partial, function(v){ partialDuration += v.d; });

                    // If already sufficiently long, then we don't need to add any pattern sections
                    var fullPattern;
                    if ( partialDuration >= fillDuration ) {
                        fullPattern = partial;
                    } else {
                        // Figure out total length of pattern
                        var patternDuration = 0; $.map(pattern, function(v){ patternDuration += v.d; });

                        // Calculate minimum number of pattern repetitions required
                        // However first check if patternDuration is zero. In which case, avoid a divide by zero case with infinite events.
                        // This could occur in the future if the data.json partial is used where pattern is blank, and event timer extended beyond 23hrs + 60*2 + 15 
                        var patternQty = 0;
                        if (patternDuration !== 0) {
                            patternQty = Math.ceil( (fillDuration - partialDuration) / patternDuration);
                        }

                        // Repeat pattern - can use this when we remove IE support later:
                        // var repeatedPattern = Array(patternQty).fill().map(function(){ return pattern; });
                        var repeatedPattern = 'z'.repeat(patternQty).split('').map(function() { return pattern; });

                        // Collapse nested arrays and concatenate with the initial partial pattern
                        fullPattern = partial.concat($.map(repeatedPattern, function(v) { return v; }));
                    }

                    // Now insert start and end markers
                    var sCumulative = 0;
                    fullPattern = $.map(fullPattern, function(v) {

                        // Don't bother appending if cumulative start time is outside range of interest
                        if ( sCumulative >= fillDuration ) {
                            return
                        }

                        // Update current object
                        v.s = sCumulative;
                        v.e = v.s + v.d;

                        // Update for next
                        sCumulative = v.s + v.d;

                        // Return current - note if you try to return v then it caches the result and every object returned is the same as the last one
                        return {
                            r: v.r,
                            d: v.d,
                            s: v.s,
                            e: v.e
                        };
                    });
                    return fullPattern;
                }

                var fullMetas = {};
                $.each(eventData, function(k, v) {
                    // Don't bother calculating if the meta hasn't been requested
                    if ( preferences.metaSequence.indexOf(k) == -1 ) {
                        return
                    }
                    fullMetas[k] = eventData[k];
                    fullMetas[k].sequences.full = fullPatternGenerator(preferences, v.sequences.partial, v.sequences.pattern);
                });

                return fullMetas;
            }

            // Utility function #12: Move the pointer to a new horizontal location based on the current time.
            function movePointer(preferences, justCreated) {
                var now = new Date();
                var hour = now.getUTCHours();
                var minute = now.getUTCMinutes();
                var currentMarkerTimeInMinutesUTC = hour * 60 + minute;
                
                var maxElapsed = preferences.viewMinutes;
                if (preferences.useMostRecentHourStart) {
                    if (preferences.viewStart === 'half-hourly') {
                        maxElapsed = 30;
                    } else {
                        maxElapsed = 60;
                    }
                }

                // Check if pointer has gone far enough along, in which case redraw everything.
                // Modulo 1440 is required to handle the midnight case since the global_startTimeInMinutesUTC hasn't been recalculated yet.
                // Also handle the case where time appears to have gone backwards (user tabbed out while the that the daily reset occurred) - marker is left of the start time.
                if (!justCreated &&
                        ( (((currentMarkerTimeInMinutesUTC - global_startTimeInMinutesUTC - maxElapsed) % 1440) >= 0) ||
                          (((currentMarkerTimeInMinutesUTC - global_startTimeInMinutesUTC) % 1440) < 0)
                        )
                    ) {
                    // Erase existing event bars
                    $('#event-container').html('');

                    // Add new ones based on the new time
                    createEventBars(preferences);
                }

                // Move the pointer
                var percentOfViewingWindow = 100 * (currentMarkerTimeInMinutesUTC - global_startTimeInMinutesUTC) / (preferences.viewMinutes + preferences.viewMinutesFuture);
                $('.event-pointer').css('left', percentOfViewingWindow + '%');

                // Check if pointer is beyond ~68% (avoid clashing between red and gray markers with moderately small screens)
                if (percentOfViewingWindow > 68) {
                    $('.event-pointer-time').css('right', '0px');
                } else {
                    $('.event-pointer-time').css('right', 'inherit');
                }

                // Update local time too
                var timezoneOffsetString = '';
                if (global_timezoneOffsetHours === 0) {
                    if (preferences.useTwelveHour == false) {
                        $('.event-pointer span').text(pad(hour) + ':' + pad(minute) + ' UTC');
                    } else {
                        $('.event-pointer span').text((((hour + 11) % 12) + 1) + ':' + pad(minute) + ' ' + (hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'));
                    }
                } else {
                    // For positive timezones, add a plus sign before the hour offset. Negative timezones already have a minus sign.
                    timezoneOffsetString = 'UTC' + (global_timezoneOffsetHours < 0 ? '' : '+' ) + global_timezoneOffsetHours;
                    if (preferences.useTwelveHour == false) {
                        $('.event-pointer span').text(pad(now.getHours()) + ':' + pad(now.getMinutes()) + ' ' + timezoneOffsetString );
                    } else {
                        $('.event-pointer span').text((((now.getHours() + 11) % 12) + 1) + ':' + pad(now.getMinutes()) + ' ' + (now.getHours() >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'));
                    }
                }
            }

            // Utility function #13: Allowing shuffling forwards and backwards
            function timeshiftOnClick(preferences) {
                // Allow user to shuffle forwards and backwards by clicking on the gray markers
                $('.event-limit-text').css('cursor', 'pointer');

                $('.event-limit-text').on('click.timeshift', function(e) {
                    $('.event-pointer').css('left', '0%');
                    $('.event-pointer-time').text(uitext.timeshiftresume);
                    $('.event-limit-text.prev').css('display', 'inherit');
                    $('.event-limit-text.prev').prop('title', uitext.timeshiftprevhover);
                    $('.event-limit-text.next').prop('title', uitext.timeshiftnexthover);

                    // Figure out if next or prev was clicked
                    if (e.target.classList.contains('next')) {
                        global_otherMinuteOffset = global_otherMinuteOffset + preferences.viewMinutes;
                    } else {
                        global_otherMinuteOffset = global_otherMinuteOffset - preferences.viewMinutes;
                    }

                    // Restrict it to a max of 24 hours offset
                    global_otherMinuteOffset = global_otherMinuteOffset % 1440;

                    // Check if offset is back to zero
                    if (global_otherMinuteOffset == 0) {
                        // reload with restart live updating
                        mainEventTimer(true, false);
                    } else {
                        // reload but paused
                        mainEventTimer(true, true);
                    }
                });
                // Restart live updating after clicking on the red marker
                $('.event-pointer-time').on('click.ontimeshiftreset', function(e) {
                    mainEventTimer(true, false);
                });
            }

            // Utility function #14: Refit compact timer to window width on resize. Only visible with the "Compact view" checkbox ticked. H4 headings 220px to left
            function fitTimerToWindowWidth() {
                var w = $('#mw-content-text')[0].offsetWidth;
                $('#EventTimerCSS3').text( '#event-wrapper.compact { width: ' + (w - (220 + 20)) + 'px } ');
            };

            // Utility function #15: Create wiki like links; inactive when on the same page as linked to.
            function wikiLink(pageName, text) {
                text = text || pageName.replace(/_/g, " ");
                pageName = pageName.replace(/ /g, "_");

                var pageTitlePattern = /(?:(?:\/wiki\/)(.*?)(?:\?|#|$)|(?:title=)(.*?)(?:&|#|$))/;
                var match = pageTitlePattern.exec(location.href);
                var current = match[1] || match[2];

                if (current === pageName) {
                    return $(document.createElement("a")).attr("class", "mw-selflink selflink").text(text);
                } else {
                    return $(document.createElement("a")).attr("href", "/wiki/" + pageName).attr("title", pageName.replace(/_/g, " ")).text(text);
                }
            }


            // MAIN FUNCTION

                // If the timer was reloaded via apply, or scrolled, reset event content and timers, otherwise its the first run and we need to create the preferences user interface.
                if (reloaded || paused) {

                    clearInterval(global_setIntervalHandle);
                } else if (zoneParameter == '') {
                    // Display checkboxes if showing every timer (probably on the Event timers page)

                // Collect preferences from localStorage

                    useMostRecentHourStart: getEventTimerPreferences('usemostrecenthourstart', uitext.checkboxes.usemostrecenthourstart.defaultvalue),
                    useTwelveHour: getEventTimerPreferences('twelvehour', uitext.checkboxes.twelvehour.defaultvalue),
                    useTopTimes: getEventTimerPreferences('toptimes', uitext.checkboxes.toptimes.defaultvalue),
                    useStickyTimes: getEventTimerPreferences('stickytimes', uitext.checkboxes.stickytimes.defaultvalue),
                    useCompact: getEventTimerPreferences('compact', uitext.checkboxes.compact.defaultvalue),
                    hideCategories: getEventTimerPreferences('hidecategories', uitext.checkboxes.hidecategories.defaultvalue),
                    hideHeadings: getEventTimerPreferences('hideheadings', uitext.checkboxes.hideheadings.defaultvalue),

                    viewMinutes: Number(getEventTimerPreferences('viewminutes', uitext.dropdowns.viewminutes.defaultvalue)),
                    viewMinutesFuture: Number(getEventTimerPreferences('viewminutesfuture', uitext.dropdowns.viewminutesfuture.defaultvalue)),
                    viewStart: 'hourly'

                    setEventTimerPreferences('sequence', global_defaultSequence);
                }

                // Respect preferences if given and the zone parameter is specified

                if (zoneParameter !== '') {

                    // Validate zone inputs exist in the full list

                    var zones = [];
                    $.each(zoneParameter.replace(', ',',').split(','), function(i, v) {
                        if (whitelist.indexOf(v) !== -1) {
                            zones.push(v);
                        }
                    });

                    // Check if there are no valid options remaining
                    if (zones.length === 0) {
                        console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Error - No valid options provided within the zone parameter (' + zoneParameter + ')');
                        $('#event-wrapper').addClass('error').text('Widget:Event timer: Error - No valid options provided within the zone parameter (' + zoneParameter + ')');
                        return;
                    } else if (zones.length === 1) {
                        $('#event-wrapper').addClass('zone-single');
                    }

                    // Check successful, continue - overwrite metaSequence
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('zone');
                    preferences.useTopTimes = false;
                    preferences.useStickyTimes = false;
                    preferences.useCompact = false;
                    preferences.hideCategories = true;
                    preferences.hideHeadings = false;
                    preferences.hideChatLinks = false;
                    preferences.disableDragAndDrop = true;
                    preferences.metaSequence = [];
                    $.each(zones, function(i, v) {
                        preferences.metaSequence.push(v);
                    });
                } else {
                    // Zone parameter is blank
                    // Exclusions
                    $.each(excludeParameter.replace(', ',',').split(','), function(i, v) {
                        var index = preferences.metaSequence.indexOf(v);
                        if (index !== -1) {
                            preferences.metaSequence.splice(index, 1);
                        }
                    });

                    // Check if there are no valid options remaining
                    if (preferences.metaSequence.length == 0) {
                        console.log('[[Widget:Event timer]]: Error - Exclusions resulted in no valid options being provided (' + excludeParameter + ')');
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // Check if using mobile view, in which show smaller time period and prevent accidental drag and drop (much more likely).
                if ( $('body').hasClass('skin-minerva') ) {
                    preferences.viewMinutes = 60;
                    preferences.viewMinutesFuture = 0;
                    $('#viewminutes-dropdown').attr('disabled', true);
                    $('#viewminutesfuture-dropdown').attr('disabled', true);

                    preferences.disableDragAndDrop = true;
                    $('#disabledraganddrop-toggle').attr('disabled', true);
                    
                    preferences.useMostRecentHourStart = true;
                    $('#usemostrecenthourstart-toggle').attr('disabled', true);
                    preferences.viewStart = 'half-hourly';
                }

                // Use viewer preferences immediately where possible
                if (preferences.useTopTimes === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('toptimes');
                }
                if (preferences.useStickyTimes === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('stickytimes');
                }
                if (preferences.useCompact === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('compact');
                }
                if (preferences.hideCategories === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('hidecategories');
                }
                if (preferences.hideHeadings === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('hideheadings');
                }
                if (preferences.hideChatLinks === true) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('hidechatlinks');
                }
                if (preferences.reduceFillerEventColors === false) {
                    $('#event-wrapper').addClass('fullcolor');
                }
                if (preferences.viewMinutesFuture === 0) {
                    $('.event-limit-text.next').css('right', '0px');
                    $('.event-limit-text.prev').css('margin-top', '2em').css('margin-right', '0px');
                } else {

                } else {
                    $('.event-limit-text.prev').css('display', 'none');
                    global_otherMinuteOffset = 0;

                    global_customEventData = eventsGenerator(preferences, jsonData.events);
                    createEventBars(preferences);
                    movePointer(preferences, true);

                    // Recurring tasks: Move the pointer every 10 seconds. The same function redraws the segmented bars if it needs to reset the page.

                    fitTimerToWindowWidth();
